qa_pairs.question: Which NBR directive first established the fiscal year 2021-2022 import entitlement for a duty-free shop at Hazrat Shah Amanat International Airport?
qa_pairs.explanation: The NBR directive dated 2022-05-23 (src=20220523_output.json) formalized the import entitlement for Mesers Bellagio Ltd for the 2021-2022 fiscal year.

qa_pairs.question: When did the NBR first apply the fiscal year import entitlement model to a diplomatic bonded warehouse for the 2022-2023 period?
qa_pairs.explanation: According to the directive dated 2022-06-02 (src=20220602_output.json), the NBR applied the entitlement model to Eastern Diplomatic Services Ltd for the 2022-2023 fiscal year.

qa_pairs.question: Which entity received an import entitlement of 12.45 lakh USD for the 2022-2023 fiscal year under the 2022-06-06 NBR directive?
qa_pairs.explanation: The NBR directive dated 2022-06-06 (src=20220606_output.json) specified an import entitlement of 12.45 lakh USD for Mesers Saber Traders Ltd for the 2022-2023 fiscal year.

qa_pairs.question: Under which legal authority do the NBR directives from May and June 2022 set annual import quotas for bonded warehouse entities?
qa_pairs.explanation: All provided documents (2022-05-23, 2022-06-02, and 2022-06-06) cite Section 13(2) of the Customs Act, 1969 as the source of authority for determining import eligibility and quotas.

qa_pairs.scenario: An operator managing a duty-free shop at an international airport received their annual import entitlement under the NBR directive on 2022-05-23. Subsequently, in early June 2022, the NBR issued new directives on 2022-06-02 and 2022-06-06 regarding bonded warehouse establishments.
qa_pairs.question: How did the scope of the NBR's Section 13(2) import entitlement determinations evolve between the 2022-05-23 directive and the directives issued on 2022-06-02 and 2022-06-06?
qa_pairs.answer: The scope expanded from specifically authorizing an annual import quota for a duty-free shop at an international airport (2022-05-23) to applying the fiscal year entitlement model to diplomatic bonded warehouse establishments (2022-06-02 and 2022-06-06).

qa_pairs.question: In the NBR directive issued 10 days after the May 23, 2022, initial formalization for a duty-free shop, how did the scope of the fiscal year entitlement model expand?
qa_pairs.answer: The NBR directive on 2022-06-02 expanded the application of the fiscal year entitlement model to diplomatic bonded warehouse facilities, specifically authorizing the annual import quota for M/S Eastern Diplomatic Services Ltd for the 2022-2023 fiscal year.

qa_pairs.question: Following the directive issued on June 2, 2022, what occurred 4 days later regarding the NBR's authority over bonded warehouse import entitlements?
qa_pairs.answer: On 2022-06-06, the NBR continued the application of the fiscal year entitlement model by issuing a specific annual import entitlement for another diplomatic bonded warehouse establishment, M/S Saber Traders Ltd, for the 2022-2023 fiscal year.
